skills.name: Navigation Support
skills.summary: Summon Squeakie to shoot three shots in a row, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Searchlight Service
skills.summary: When in Yellow Light Mode, use Resonance Skill to perform Pounce, which consumes STA to pounce on the target before switching to Red Light Mode.

skills.name: Squeakie Express
skills.summary: Throw the giant Squeakie at the target, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Signal Light
skills.summary: When Yellow Light Spark is fully recovered, replace Resonance Skill with Resonance Skill Energized Pounce that deals Electro DMG and enter Red Spotlight Mode.

skills.name: Pathfinding
skills.summary: Gain 10% Electro DMG Bonus when in Red Light Mode.

skills.name: Expediting
skills.summary: Casting Energized Pounce or Energized Rebound increases ATK by 10% for 5s.

skills.name: Special Delivery
skills.summary: Enter Yellow Light Mode and attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: Escorting
skills.summary: The incoming Resonator has their Resonance Skill DMG Amplified by 38% for 10s or until they are switched out.
